question: A charged particle enters a uniform magnetic field making an angle $\theta$ with the field direction. Explain why its path becomes helical. Obtain expressions for the radius and pitch of the helix in terms of $v$, $\theta$, $q$, $m$ and $B$.

options.A: The path is circular because both $v\sin\theta$ and $v\cos\theta$ experience magnetic force. The radius is $r=\dfrac{mv\cos\theta}{qB}$ and pitch is $p=\dfrac{2\pi mv\sin\theta}{qB}$.
options.B: The path is parabolic because the magnetic field accelerates the particle along itself. The radius is $r=\dfrac{qB}{mv\sin\theta}$ and pitch is $p=\dfrac{qB}{2\pi mv\cos\theta}$.
options.C: Resolve velocity as $v_\perp=v\sin\theta$ and $v_\parallel=v\cos\theta$. The perpendicular component produces circular motion, while the parallel component gives uniform motion along $\vec B$; together they form a helix. Thus $r=\dfrac{mv\sin\theta}{qB}$ and $p=v_\parallel\left(\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}\right)=\dfrac{2\pi mv\cos\theta}{qB}$.
options.D: The path is helical with $r=\dfrac{mv\cos\theta}{qB}$ and $p=\dfrac{2\pi mv\sin\theta}{qB}$.
